identity.name: Mobile Workflow — Working with Mandala from Android
identity.description: Complete guide for External SR working from Android/Termux. Includes core SR principles, system flow, mobile-specific commands, post-check mandate, and self-learning reference.

golden_rule.title: ONE COPY — ONE ACTION — FULL DEPLOY
golden_rule.description: Every code block marked as 'FULL DEPLOY' is a COMPLETE command. It creates/updates the file, adds to git, commits, and pushes to GitHub. Copy ONCE, paste ONCE, press ENTER.
golden_rule.example: When you see a block starting with 'cat > ... << EOF' and ending with 'git push', that's the whole thing.

core_principles.description: Fundamental rules for External SR — apply to both PC and mobile.
core_principles.api_first: Before modifying any file, request its current content via GitHub API (bypasses CDN). Raw URL has 5-10 min delay.
core_principles.always_fetch_before_update: NEVER assume local state. ALWAYS fetch the current version via API before preparing an update.

steps: 3. Send link to Gardener, wait for content

core_principles.post_check_mandate: CRITICAL. After patch, request updated file via API. WAIT for content. Read it. Confirm SHA and version. NEVER report success until file is received and verified. Verbal confirmation without content = protocol violation.
core_principles.laconic_communication: Responses must be concise. Avoid showing unnecessary code. Only output what Gardener needs to see or execute.
core_principles.copyable_links: When providing URLs, wrap them in a code block with 'text' language (```text ... ```) so the 'Copy' button appears.
core_principles.git_commit_in_script: Always include 'git add', 'git commit', and 'git push' inside the SAME command block.

self_learning.reference: External SR may propose learned rules. See honeycombs/instructions/mobile_workflow.json#learned_rules. Format: rule + context + bad/good examples. Gardener approval required before patching.

full_deploy_pattern.description: External SR will provide updates in this format. Copy the WHOLE block.
full_deploy_pattern.template:
cat > honeycombs/path/to/file.json << 'EOF'
{ ... full JSON content ... }
EOF
git add honeycombs/path/to/file.json
git commit -m "feat: description"
git push

voice_input_note.description: Gardener uses voice input on mobile. Sometimes transcription is inaccurate.
voice_input_note.rule: If a word or phrase is unclear, External SR should: 1) Logically infer based on Mandala context (honeycombs, tasks, garden, etc.), or 2) Ask for clarification.
